data.title: Reward Minerals Wins Approval for First Drilling at Newfoundland Gold-Copper Prospect
data.description:
Reward Minerals Limited ( (AU:RWD) ) has shared an update.

Reward Minerals has secured statutory approvals from Newfoundland and Labrador authorities to commence a maiden seven-hole diamond drilling campaign at the Jackpot gold-copper prospect within its Mountain Pond Project in Canada. Jackpot hosts an outcropping mineralised quartz vein in a shear zone, with historic and recent rock chip assays returning high-grade gold and copper, underscoring the prospect’s potential.

Site access refurbishment and drill pad preparation are scheduled to start in mid-September ahead of drilling, marking the first-ever drill test at Mountain Pond. Recent soil sampling has strengthened the gold anomaly at the nearby Bingo prospect and defined a new anomaly at High Stakes, together forming a 1.2km prospective corridor that will guide Reward’s short- and medium-term exploration priorities across the project.

Reward Minerals Limited is an Australian-listed exploration company focused on precious and base metals, with projects in Newfoundland, Canada, and Western Australia. Its Mountain Pond Gold Project in central northern Newfoundland comprises 41 contiguous claims over roughly 10 square kilometres of underexplored terrane, positioned along the mineralised Sullivan Pond Fault corridor and near established mining service infrastructure.

The company is advancing multiple prospects within Mountain Pond, including the Jackpot, Bingo and High Stakes gold-copper targets that together define a 1.2km mineralised corridor. Reward has been implementing systematic soil and rock chip sampling, data compilation and regional exploration to refine drill-ready targets and expand its footprint in a district hosting current and emerging gold operations.

data.title: Stelar Metals Advances Hill of Leaders Tungsten Exploration With Maiden Soil Survey
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Stelar Metals Limited ( (AU:SLB) ).

Stelar Metals has completed a maiden regional-scale soil geochemical survey at its Hill of Leaders tungsten project in the Northern Territory, collecting 1,350 samples across about 50 square kilometres of granite terrain. The company has also amended an earlier announcement to include visual scheelite abundance estimates and a JORC Table 1, signed off by its exploration manager as the competent person.

The survey results, expected in the coming weeks, will inform targets for subsequent drilling phases, with the first bedrock drilling program at Hill of Leaders scheduled to start next week. Reconnaissance work has confirmed abundant fluorescent scheelite in both veins and granite, opening a new exploration direction, while sector tailwinds from Chinese export controls and U.S. restrictions on Chinese tungsten underscore the strategic relevance of Stelar’s emerging tungsten position.

data.title: Unisound AI launches U2-Flash core model and shifts toward self-improving training
data.description:
Unisound AI Technology Co., Ltd. ( (HK:9678) ) has issued an update.

Unisound AI Technology has unveiled U2-Flash, a new-generation high-density core model built on its U2 foundation model, delivering major gains in coding benchmarks, task completion quality and efficiency versus the prior version and several rival models. The sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture activates only a fraction of its 266 billion parameters per inference, enabling faster response times, lower token consumption and flagship-level performance in programming, reasoning and agent tasks while remaining compatible with leading domestic compute infrastructures.

The company also introduced an autonomous closed-loop training system in which U2-Flash participates in task generation, trajectory analysis and error correction, marking its first practical step toward recursive self-improvement under strict safety, traceability and sandbox controls. Management positions this shift from human-led training to model-aided evolution as a foundation for long-term compounding capability gains and broader industrial deployment of high-density intelligence, with the goal of enhancing operational efficiency and creating sustained value for shareholders.
